summary: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask…
whenToUse: Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area.
